checks.proves: Partner financial presentation and DSH/WLT application boundary consumers are explicitly mapped.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove ledger balance, authorization or reconciliation runtime behavior.
checks.passCriteria: Every Partner financial display/mutation resolves to the governed WLT boundary and no frontend/DSH authoritative calculation is found.
checks.failCriteria: Local financial truth, caller-authoritative amount or unbounded financial mutation is found.

checks.proves: WLT backend compiles and its Go tests pass after Partner finance changes.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not by itself prove DSH proxy/mobile runtime or representative database migration path.

checks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command '$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"; pnpm runtime:wlt:migrate; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; foreach ($test in @("services/wlt/database/tests/cod-custody-invariants.sql","services/wlt/database/tests/payout-destination-invariants.sql","services/wlt/database/tests/settlement-commission-invariants.sql")) { Get-Content -LiteralPath $test -Raw | docker compose --env-file infra/docker/env/runtime.env.example -f infra/docker/compose.runtime.yml exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U bthwani_runtime -d wlt_runtime; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; node --test services/wlt/tests/wlt-database-authority.test.mjs; exit $LASTEXITCODE'
checks.proves: The current governed WLT migration runner applies the manifest to local PostgreSQL, Partner-relevant COD custody, payout-destination and settlement/commission SQL invariants execute against wlt_runtime, and the current database-authority test confirms retired probe/legacy-ledger authorities remain deleted.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not grant finance approval and does not prove production/provider reconciliation or production data behavior.
checks.passCriteria: Governed WLT migration, all three Partner-relevant SQL invariant suites, and wlt-database-authority.test.mjs exit zero.
checks.failCriteria: Any migration, SQL invariant, legacy-authority or database-authority check fails.

checks.proves: Partner finance/COD application-facing readback is exercised with the same Partner runtime candidate where covered by the script.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not substitute for independent finance approval or production/provider evidence.
checks.passCriteria: Partner financial reads are scoped and COD mutation/readback does not fabricate success or bypass reconciliation.
checks.failCriteria: Any actor-scope, mutation, reconciliation or canonical-readback assertion fails.
